questions.stem: A 45-year-old male presented with complaints of fever and a pruritic inguinal rash. The patient had noticed a reddish-brown rash in the inguinal region for the past 4 days that was pruritic and malodorous. He had a past medical history of hypertension, diabetes mellitus, and dyslipidemia. He was started on antibiotics. An abdominal ultrasound taken 3 days later showed mild hepatomegaly. Considering the patient’s worsening ALF, drug-induced hepatotoxicity secondary to drug usage was suspected. Which of the following drugs are involved in the development of Acute liver failure?
